mapper.sql: a.id,a.project_id,p.project_name,a.granularity,a.topic_type_code,a.doc_code AS asset_code,a.doc_name AS asset_name,a.topic_summary,m.attachment_id,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(s.name ORDER BY s.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM dm_topic_system ts JOIN dm_component c ON c.tenant_id=ts.tenant_id AND c.project_id=ts.project_id AND c.system_code=ts.system_code JOIN arch_physical_subsystem s ON s.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND s.code=c.system_code AND s.deleted=0 WHERE ts.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ts.topic_id=a.id) AS system_names,(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(ts.system_code ORDER BY ts.system_code SEPARATOR ', ') FROM dm_topic_system ts WHERE ts.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ts.topic_id=a.id) AS system_codes,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_content_attachment ca WHERE ca.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ca.business_type='TOPIC' AND ca.business_id=a.id AND ca.deleted=0) AS attachment_count,a.owner_id,a.created_by,a.created_at,a.updated_by,a.updated_at

FROM dm_topic a LEFT JOIN dm_content_attachment m ON m.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND m.business_type='TOPIC' AND m.business_id=a.id AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN pm_project p ON a.project_id=p.id AND p.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND p.deleted=0

WHERE a.tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND a.project_id=#{p.projectId} AND a.deleted=#{p.deleted} AND a.granularity=#{p.granularity} AND a.topic_type_code=#{p.topicTypeCode} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dm_topic_system ts WHERE ts.tenant_id=a.tenant_id AND ts.topic_id=a.id AND ts.system_code IN #{code}) AND (a.doc_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%') OR a.topic_summary LIKE CONCAT('%',#{p.keyword},'%'))
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY a.doc_code ASC,a.id ASCa.updated_at DESC,a.id DESC LIMIT #{p.limit} OFFSET #{p.offset}
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=0
SELECT WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.id=#{id} AND a.deleted=1
SELECT id,tenant_id,project_id,granularity,topic_type_code,doc_code,doc_name,topic_summary,owner_id FROM dm_topic WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
mapper.update: UPDATE dm_topic SET doc_name=#{p.docName},granularity=#{p.granularity},topic_type_code=#{p.topicTypeCode},topic_summary=#{p.topicSummary},updated_by=#{p.actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{p.id} AND tenant_id=#{p.tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_topic SET deleted=1,deleted_by=#{actorId},deleted_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=0
UPDATE dm_topic SET deleted=0,deleted_by=NULL,deleted_at=NULL,updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_topic WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
DELETE FROM dm_topic_system WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND topic_id=#{topicId}
mapper.select: SELECT system_code FROM dm_topic_system WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND topic_id=#{topicId} ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dm_component WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND project_id=#{projectId} AND system_code=#{systemCode} AND enabled=1
SELECT attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND business_type='TOPIC' AND business_id=#{topicId} AND deleted=0

SELECT m.attachment_id FROM dm_content_attachment m JOIN dm_topic a ON a.id=m.business_id AND a.tenant_id=m.tenant_id WHERE m.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND m.business_type='TOPIC' AND m.business_id=#{topicId} AND m.sort_order=0 AND m.deleted=0 AND a.deleted=0
SELECT project_id FROM dm_topic WHERE id=#{id} AND tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND deleted=1
